name.description: Display name for this SDR receiver/stream.

stream_url.description: URL to open or listen to the stream.

description.description: What this receiver covers, antenna setup, usage notes, etc.

frequency_info.description: Frequency range or bands covered, e.g. "0-30 MHz HF" or "144-148 MHz (2m)".

verification_status.description: Moderation status. Only approved streams are visible publicly. Submissions start as pending.

review_notes.description: Admin notes recorded during review of a submission.

submitted_by_name.description: Display name of the user who submitted this stream.

source_name.description: Set when this record was imported from an external directory (e.g. "rx-tx.info") rather than submitted by a member. Drives an attribution link on the public listing.

source_url.description: Link back to the external directory this record was imported from, shown alongside source_name.
